verdict.rationale: Type inference for component inputs and outputs is a fair axis for a TypeScript UI framework. The evidence never documents it. The pack only shows that Angular uses TypeScript, that components have @Input/@Output (angular-comm-1), and that state uses Signals. None of this shows inputs or emitted events being typed automatically without annotations. One early community report (angular-comm-4) even says template typos went unchecked at compile time.
